therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of participants with adjudicated renal response at Week 52

results.effect_size: OR 2.65 (95% CI: 1.64–4.27); voclosporin 73/179 (40.8%) vs placebo 40/178 (22.5%) renal responders
biomarker_changes: UPCR reduced from baseline 4.14 mg/mg (voclosporin) and 3.87 mg/mg (placebo) at baseline; voclosporin arm showed greater UPCR reduction at all timepoints through Week 52
eGFR change from baseline was slightly negative in voclosporin arm (−1.5 mL/min/1.73m² at Week 52) vs slightly positive in placebo arm (+1.5 mL/min/1.73m²)
SELENA-SLEDAI improved in both arms with no significant between-group difference at Week 24 (LS mean diff −0.5, p=0.373) or Week 52 (LS mean diff −0.5, p=0.277)
subgroup_findings: Renal response at Week 24: voclosporin 58/179 vs placebo 35/178, OR 2.23 (95% CI: 1.34–3.72), p=0.002
UPCR ≤0.5 mg/mg achieved: voclosporin 116/179 vs placebo 78/178, HR 2.02 (95% CI: 1.51–2.7), p<0.001
Median time to UPCR ≤0.5 mg/mg: 169 days (voclosporin) vs 372 days (placebo)
50% UPCR reduction achieved: voclosporin 173/179 vs placebo 135/178; median time 29 days vs 63 days, HR 2.05 (95% CI: 1.62–2.6), p<0.001
Partial renal response (50% UPCR reduction) at Week 24: voclosporin 126 vs placebo 89, OR 2.43 (95% CI: 1.56–3.79), p<0.001
Partial renal response at Week 52: voclosporin 125 vs placebo 92, OR 2.26 (95% CI: 1.45–3.51), p<0.001
Renal response with low-dose steroids at Week 52: voclosporin 64 vs placebo 36, OR 2.44 (95% CI: 1.48–4.00), p<0.001
Duration of renal response (time to 2nd UPCR >0.5 mg/mg): median 216 days (voclosporin) vs 198 days (placebo), HR 0.81 (95% CI: 0.53–1.25), p=0.349 (not significant)
SF-36 and LupusPRO quality of life improvements were similar between arms with no statistically significant differences
safety_signals: Serious adverse events included pneumonia (voclosporin 7/178, placebo 8/178), gastroenteritis (voclosporin 3/178), urinary tract infection (voclosporin 2/178, placebo 1/178)
eGFR was modestly lower in voclosporin arm vs placebo at most timepoints, consistent with calcineurin inhibitor class effect on renal hemodynamics

context.comparator: Placebo oral capsule (plus background mycophenolate mofetil and low-dose steroids)
